name: First Note
hint: Tap a tile: its ring follows the arrows, one tile per beat. Your chain plays the tune shown above.

name: Gaps
hint: Rings leap over empty slots to the next tile in line.

name: Split
hint: A split tile always rings out of both its sides, whichever side the ring came in from. Several taps ring every tile, but only one plays the tune.

name: Branches
hint: Many starts ring every tile. Listen: only one plays the tune.

name: Hush
hint: Striped tiles stay silent unless two rings hit them on the same beat; then they join the chord.

name: Delay
hint: Hourglass tiles hold the ring one extra beat before passing it on.

name: Turn
hint: Gold dials only turn: tap one to rotate it clockwise (right-click or hold to turn back). A dial can never start the chain, so tune the dials, then tap a plain tile.

name: Chorus
hint: Splits, silence, delay and a dial: count the beats. Dials turn when tapped; they never start the chain.

name: Tuning
hint: Three dials. Every setting rings, only one sings. Dials turn when tapped; they never start the chain.

name: Finale
hint: Everything you know, together. Dials turn when tapped; they never start the chain.
